_about: Every limit the owner may change on the dashboard (Limits tab), read by the bot (trader/src/lib/overrides.ts) and the dashboard (dashboard/settings.py).
A change is stored in the database (kv `key`) until set back; without one the bot uses config/config.yaml or, for risk.*, trader/src/risk/limits.ts.
min/max are in the stored unit. For risk.* they must equal RISK_WALLS in limits.ts (a test checks): those walls are code, and the bot ignores anything outside them.
show: percent = a fraction shown as %, bps = basis points shown as %, minutes = milliseconds shown as minutes; otherwise the value is shown as is with `unit`.
rules: [a, b] means a must stay below b. A stored pair that breaks a rule is ignored by the bot (both fall back to normal).
